QuestInfo.name: Puking Expression
QuestInfo.0: #p1052121# is convinced you should take an #bacting class#k. What kind of class might it be? Talk to #p1052121# standing in front of the Hair Salon in #bHenesys Market#k.
QuestInfo.1: Of all the things you could do with your life, you have opted to learn the puking expression. You can learn it by going to a #p1092000# and asking #b#p1092000##k to make the dish that #p1052121# has requested.
QuestInfo.2: You have learned the puking expression.

0.0: Hello, #h0#. I'm so proud of you. Are you ready to continue your acting lessons?

yes.0: Now, for the most gracious expressions of all: The puking expression. This expression has challenged generations of thespians. The pathos of puking, the internal conflict suddenly and violent made external... It is a mark of a true actor to be able to hurl on command.
yes.1: See #b#p1092000##k, chef of the #bNautilus#k. Ask #p1052121# to give you the dish I ordered ahead for you. Talk to #p1092000# after you eat it, and you will learn the puking expression.

no.0: You have real talent! I'd hate to see it burn out before your career even begins!

npc.0: You haven't left to see #b#p1092000##k yet? He's the chef of the #bNautilus#k.
